evidence.description: The actor directly accesses EcosiaBrowserWindowAuthManager.shared to dispatch authentication state rather than receiving the operational service through a replaceable dependency boundary.

candidates.explanation: Authentication-state dispatch depends directly on another component's singleton service. This dependency is hard-coded rather than explicitly supplied.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: getSessionTransferToken checks isLoggedIn, then suspends while retrieving SSO credentials and stores the result without revalidating the login state.
Logout calls setupTokensWithCredentials(nil) when credentials are cleared, providing a visible path that changes authentication state while SSO retrieval can be suspended.
setupTokensWithCredentials defaults the login-state argument to false and assigns it to the actor's mutable isLoggedIn property.

candidates.explanation: getSessionTransferToken relies on its pre-suspension logged-in check when storing retrieved SSO credentials. Actor reentrancy allows logout to set isLoggedIn to false during retrieval, but the method does not revalidate that prerequisite before committing the credentials.
candidates.title: Unsafe Actor State Assumption After Suspension
